candidates.title: Moomoo NASDAQ and NYSE short-activity entry admission
candidates.hypothesis: Entry-admission alpha: exclude the next-session core long entry when nasdaq_shares_short divided by total_shares_short is at or above its strictly-prior-60-row 70th percentile; insufficient history is neutral.

market_prior.provenance: The cash-feasible core ranking uses only frozen behavior inputs and OHLCV bars known by the signal close.

independent_evidence.state: nasdaq_shares_short divided by total_shares_short is at or above its within-ticker 70th percentile versus the strictly prior 60 activity rows, with at least 40 prior rows
independent_evidence.provenance: Authenticated Moomoo daily short-volume activity archive; activity_date is usable no earlier than the next tradable session.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The existing price state says admit the core long candidate, while an unusually NASDAQ-concentrated short-activity venue mix says the apparent strength faces information-sensitive sell pressure not represented by aggregate short-volume ratio.

transmission.expected_direction: exclude the flagged next-session core long entry
transmission.catalyst: Next-session price discovery incorporates venue-concentrated short activity after the source becomes usable.
causal_steps: core price state admits a long candidate
independent short activity concentrates on NASDAQ versus the ticker's own history
the flagged next-session long entry is withheld
avoiding fragile demand improves replacement value over H10

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The venue split is not the commonly used aggregate short-volume ratio, requires ticker-specific rolling history and a strict after-close-to-next-session clock, and is absent from the existing core entry contract.
candidates.falsifier: Fewer than five exact canonical baseline entry touches in any standard window, fail-open or timing mismatch in the shared policy, or failure to improve aggregate expected-value score and H10 replacement value without worse drawdown falsifies the rule.

baseline.policy: Preserve the accepted core candidate order without Moomoo venue-mix information.

treatment.policy: For the next tradable session only, exclude a core long entry when venue_share_percentile is at or above 0.70, require up to 60 strictly prior activity rows with at least 40, and remain neutral on missing history.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, and the baseline entered trade under identical costs and capital constraints.

execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: the accepted core universe liquidity and spread floors
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: canonical cash-equity costs and turnover accounting
execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: none; short activity is context for long ranking and does not authorize a short sale
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: same cash-feasible slot and notional limits as the active baseline
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: no earlier than next session after activity_date; no same-session use

prediction.confidence_reason: The field axis and entry-admission response are untried and density is broad, but mid and late baseline touches sit exactly at the preflight floor and venue attribution may be routing noise.

candidates.reopen_condition: If canonical replay drops below five entry touches in any window, park until at least ten additional exact entry touches exist; if Gate 4 rejects, only a genuinely independent source or materially sufficient newly settled forward rows may reopen it.
candidates.next_machine_action: Run outcome-blind D0-D3, then obtain an opposite-runtime challenge and independent verification before reserving a shared default-off entry-admission experiment.
